It mixes at§9 16 parallels§r (about one MAX amp) and adds the last mix, §9Entanglement Medium§r: 144 L Attractor Dark Matter + 500 L Superdense Ergomatter + 1,000 L Degenerate Stellar Mixture → 1,000 L, 120 s. §5§lTHE §lCORE§r The §9Homogeny Tier III Core§r (Condensate Assembler, MAX): 9,216 L Entangled Attractor Dark Matter (about 0.75 h of one T9), Superdense Ergomatter, Degenerate Stellar Mixture and Eternity condensates. To install it, mix 100,000 L of Degenerate Stellar Mixture at T2 first.

§5§lTHE §lMILESTONE§r Run the T2 Homogeny on a quasar link at σ ≥ 1 for an hour before you install the core. The machine does not check it; it is the practice run for the link Entanglement Medium needs (see §cA Quasar-Held Vortex§r).

Entanglement Medium needs a quasar link at σ ≥ 1; without it the run waits.

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you tick the box after an hour at σ ≥ 1, and hold the Tier III Core (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL).
